relationships.subject: Yoda1
relationships.evidence_quote: Following treatment with Yoda1, Schwann cells showed an increase in TAZ nuclear/cytosolic ratio with a clear TAZ nuclear enrichment compared to untreated Schwann cells

relationships.subject: GsMTx4
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking mechanosensitive channel activation with GsMTx4 reduced TAZ nuclear/cytosolic ratio, with a clear reduction of TAZ nuclear localization compared to untreated Schwann cells

relationships.subject: Yoda1
relationships.evidence_quote: Our data show that cocultures treated with Yoda1 present both less (70.2 ± 6.3) and shorter (77.2 μm ± 1.3) myelin segments

relationships.subject: PIEZO1
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, these results indicate that PIEZO1 is a transient inhibitor of myelination.

relationships.subject: PIEZO1
relationships.evidence_quote: The activity of both ERK and AKT was increased in Piezo1cKO P15 sciatic nerves

relationships.subject: PIEZO2
relationships.evidence_quote: Our data also suggest that PIEZO2 may be required for proper myelin thickening early during development.

key_findings: PIEZO1 and PIEZO2 are among the most abundant mechanosensitive channels in Schwann cells; PIEZO1 loss transiently increases myelination and PIEZO2 loss delays it.
PIEZO1 modulates YAP/TAZ, ERK and AKT activity in Schwann cells.
